title: Fix slow SANE startup by disabling unused backends
summary: Speed up scanner detection by commenting out unused scanner drivers in the SANE configuration file. This prevents SANE from probing devices it doesn't need.

steps.explain: Identify which drivers are currently being used by your devices.

Edit the file /etc/sane.d/dll.conf. Comment out (add # at the start of the line) the backend names that are NOT listed in the scanimage -L output. For example, if you only use 'brother4', comment out 'epson', 'hp', etc.

rollback.explain: Restore the original dll.conf file or uncomment the lines you previously commented out.

warnings: Do not comment out the backend corresponding to your actual scanner, or it will stop working.
